A [[Unidentified Sith Lord (Athiss)|Sith Lord]] was '''entombed''' on [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] a millennium later, his name was lost to history.

At that time, a group of lore-seekers visited his tomb.

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The tomb appears in the ''[[Lost Knowledge]]'' adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beta|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Beta]] book.
